claims.assertion: Yazhi describes pre-incarnation contracts as self-chosen conditions for a desired physical experience and spiritual development.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi says Earth’s limitations make her fairly sure everyone has prenatal contracts; she says the spiritual side’s contracts cannot be known.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi says hardship can aid less-developed souls, while sufficiently spiritually developed souls can progress without suffering.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: At a given level of development.

claims.assertion: Gosia views a missed personal contract as carrying no karma or punishment; she says consequences are self-imposed.
claims.speaker: Gosia
